decision.summary: A single candidate temporary offset in U begins at index 431 with a rapid drop (~−6 MAD) and persists to the end of the allowed context (469) without recovery. N/E show brief correlated fluctuations but no opposing offset, and no return is observed. Hence, the interval is classified as uncertain—consistent with either an incomplete temporary offset or a permanent step.
